answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 49036 Country: India Title: Can interest money be used to help a friend who has taken home loan to purchase a home? Question: A friend of mine requested me for some money, on returnable basis, as he is a little short of the required amount. He has also taken home loan for buying the same house. I have some interest money available with me. Can this money be used to help him in this situation, without any intention of reward? It can be considered that this interest money will be used to pay the home loan interest. Also, do I need to tell him that it is interest money? Answer ID: 49036 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 3/3/M=01/1435) Your friend did interest based dealing that he took loan from bank to buy the house. He should do taubah and istighfar for the same. He should pay the loan back as soon as possible and be free. If the said friend is indebted and indigent then interest money may be given to him without the intention of reward. It is not necessary to tell him that it is interest money. He may use it where he wishes. The interest money should be given into his complete possession. It is not right to give him as loan. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
